verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Poly shipping its own first-party plugin for other agents (Claude Code), an MCP server, and a scriptable CLI. None of these is a documented extension API or SDK, with samples and developer docs, for building your own plugins for Poly. The CLI and MCP server are adjacent building blocks or belong to other stories, and the probes found no OpenAPI or similar developer API spec.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build my own plugins against a documented extension API/SDK with samples and developer docs
